locus.output_selection: tensor output of vision encoder layer 39 of 40 (B, 1025, 1408); the tower's post_layernorm is applied to it and the result is what the Q-Former cross-attends to
locus.token_rule: all 1025 tokens (CLS + 1024 patches of the 448x448 image); the Q-Former's encoder_attention_mask is all ones, so every row is read
locus.affected_branch: the single visual stream into the Q-Former's cross-attention
locus.bypasses: none: the tower's post_layernorm is ON the consumed path (unlike LLaVA and CheXagent-2, where the tower's final LayerNorm is computed and discarded), so a write here reaches the reader through it
locus.notes: EVA-CLIP-shaped ViT, 40 layers at 448 px with 14 px patches, trained on chest radiographs by the CheXagent authors
